# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 44 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Base64 Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/base64-lab/), a free online developer tool — encode and decode Base64 text or files entirely in the browser, with auto-detect mode, a whitespace janitor that fixes broken pastes, byte stats and SHA-256 fingerprints, nothing ever leaves the page, **VWAP Tracker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/vwap-tracker/), a free online trading-education tool — plot any intraday session against its volume-weighted average price with ±1σ and ±2σ deviation bands, replay the day bar by bar, scrub any bar for its values, paste custom price/volume data, or pick from three sample sessions, educational demo using synthetic data only, **Tic-Tac-Toe vs AI** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tic-tac-toe/), a free online tic-tac-toe game — play as X or O against an easy mode you can beat or a perfect minimax opponent that never loses, with win/loss/draw scoreboard and animated win lines, **Order Book Visualizer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/orderbook-visualizer/), a free online limit order book simulator — watch a synthetic order book come alive with an animated depth chart, live ladder, and place-your-own-limit-order widget that teaches how bids, asks and spreads work, educational demo using simulated data only, **Time Converter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/timestamp-converter/), a free online developer tool — paste a Unix timestamp to read it as a human date in any timezone, or convert a date back to epoch, with automatic seconds/milliseconds/microseconds/nanoseconds detection, relative times and shareable links, all computed locally, **Mortgage Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/mortgage-calc/), a free online mortgage calculator — enter home price, down payment, rate and term to see the full monthly breakdown with taxes, insurance, HOA and PMI, a year-by-year amortisation schedule, total interest and how extra payments shorten the loan, all computed locally, **Sudoku** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/sudoku/), a free online sudoku game — fresh puzzles generated in the browser with guaranteed unique solutions, three difficulty levels, pencil notes, hints, mistake highlighting and a timer, all computed locally, **Pairs Trading Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/pairs-trading-lab/), a free online pairs-trading explorer — synthetic cointegrated price pairs with OLS hedge-ratio estimation, rolling spread z-scores, a stationarity check with half-life, and a band backtest with a full trade log, educational demo using synthetic data only, Recent additions: **Position Size Calculator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/position-size-calculator/), a free online trading tool — enter account size, risk percentage and stop distance to get exact position size in shares, dollar risk and notional value, with long/short direction and live recalculation, all computed locally, **JWT Decoder** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/jwt-decoder/), a free online developer tool that decodes JSON Web Tokens entirely in the browser — paste a token to see header, payload and signature decoded, with expiry and not-yet-valid checks and syntax highlighting, nothing ever leaves the page, **Wordle Clone** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/wordle-clone/), a free online word game — six guesses to find the daily five-letter word, with an on-screen keyboard, duplicate-safe letter coloring, practice mode and shareable emoji grids, **Habit Tracker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/habit-tracker/), a free online habit tracker — check off daily habits and watch streaks grow, with a weekly heatmap, progress ring and text export, all stored on-device
